resources.string: Pulse reads steps, calories, food, weight and sleep to show your daily balance and forecast. Nothing leaves the phone.

From Health Connect, with your permission: steps (from your Fitbit and the phone), calories burned (total and active, from your Fitbit), food entries (from MyFitnessPal), weight (from your scale\'s app) and sleep (from your Fitbit). While Pulse is open it also counts steps with the phone\'s own step sensor, so the number moves as you walk.
On this phone only: in Health Connect and in Pulse\'s own storage. No account, no servers, no analytics. Nothing leaves the phone.
Why it reads in the background
So the widgets and the morning and evening nudges stay current every 15 minutes without opening the app.
Turn off any permission in Health Connect at any time, or uninstall Pulse to remove its own copy.
A morning note after your weigh-in syncs and an 8 PM check of today\'s balance.
